neighbours.label: the spaced dot ' .' of a spaced ellipsis ('. . .')
fire: He paused at the door . . . and then walked away.
I wanted to tell her . . . but the words would not come.
Do you remember . . . the summer we spent by the lake?
The letter ended abruptly: "and if they find us . . ."
Well . . . I suppose we could try it once.
She counted slowly . . . one, two, three . . . and jumped.
The minutes dragged on . . . nobody said a thing.
And then . . . silence fell over the whole room.
